title: The coefficient class of the blueprint
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ of
[def-weil-finite-field-fiber], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$.
Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with
valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and chosen uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and an
integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$
as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $\overline X$ be a
$k$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite type
[def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Use the category
$\operatorname{Mod}(\overline X_{\Et},A)$ of sheaves of modules over the
constant coefficient sheaf on the small étale site
[def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and the category
$\operatorname{Sh}(\overline X_{\Proet},A)$ of such module sheaves on the
small pro-étale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write
$\nu_{\overline X}^*$ for the inverse-image functor on these module
sheaves of the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism].

A sheaf $\mathcal F\in\operatorname{Sh}(\overline X_{\Proet},A)$ is a
*coefficient sheaf of the blueprint's class*, or a sheaf *of étale
origin*, if there exist a sheaf
$\mathcal G\in\operatorname{Mod}(\overline X_{\Et},A)$ and an isomorphism
of $A$-module sheaves
$$
 \alpha:\nu_{\overline X}^*\mathcal G\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal F.
$$
Membership in this class means the existence of such a pair
$(\mathcal G,\alpha)$; a choice of the pair is not additional data of
$\mathcal F$.

mathlib_match.how: Specialize CategoryTheory.Functor.essImage at EssentialImage.lean:45 to C = Mod(X_Et,A), D = Sh(X_Proet,A), the module-sheaf categories supplied by def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves and def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, and the inverse-image functor F = nu_X^* supplied by def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism. At a pro-etale module sheaf H its defining predicate is exactly existence of an etale module sheaf G and Nonempty (nu_X^* G ≅ H). This is one specialization of the generic categorical definition, with no comparison of two presentations of module sheaves required. The predicate records existence, not a chosen witness; no full-faithfulness, constructibility or derived theorem is used.

split_report.summary: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: the source conflates arbitrary etale-origin sheaves with constructible sheaves and bounded constructible complexes. On Spec of an algebraically closed finite-field closure, the constant sheaf of a countably infinite direct sum of the nonzero finite coefficient ring is of etale origin but has infinite stalk and is not constructible. Removed the false equivalence, retaining exactly the source first-sentence class and the unit quantifier over every etale module sheaf. Introduced all coefficient data and cited the existing finite-field, coefficient-ring, scheme, finite-type, site, sheaf-category and comparison definitions. The resulting existential membership predicate is a one-line specialization of Mathlib Functor.essImage (line 45), so the item is a Mathlib leaf. No new nodes or proof steps.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the definition in def-sf-fullcd-used-class, first paragraph through the comparison morphism; repairs its final false equivalence. Keeps sk-prop-sf-fullcd-etale-origin statement and proof quantifier over every etale A-module sheaf. No unit proof route or chapter changed. Whole-blueprint searches for etale origin, essential image and coefficient sheaf found no second node defining exactly this sheaf class; nearby def-sf-fullcd-class adds a cohomological-dimension condition, while def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory and def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness concern derived complexes.

blueprint_update.statement:

$A=A_{E,n}$, the algebraically closed field $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$,
and a finite-type $k$-scheme $\overline X$. Call a sheaf
$\mathcal F$ of $A$-modules on the small pro-étale site
$\overline X_{\Proet}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] a
*coefficient sheaf of the blueprint's class* if it is of étale
origin: $\mathcal F\cong\nu_{\overline X}^*\mathcal G$ for a sheaf
